title: Migajasmon Oficial
description: The official Migajasmon modpack, featuring high-quality and specially curated additions, tailored for the Migajasmon Cobblemon server experience.
body:
Migajasmon is a curated Cobblemon modpack designed specifically for use on the Migajasmon multiplayer server.
The modpack focuses on stability, performance, balanced progression, and competitive-friendly gameplay, rather than excessive or experimental content.

This pack is built to support a structured multiplayer experience including:

Gyms and badge progression

Competitive VGC-style Pokémon battles

Events, missions, and server-driven content

🎮 Core Features

Cobblemon as the central gameplay experience.

Carefully selected mods to improve performance, stability, and quality of life.

Open Parties and Claims for cooperative play and base protection.

Server-aligned configurations to ensure consistent gameplay between client and server.

⚙️ Design Philosophy

Migajasmon prioritizes:

Smooth multiplayer performance

Reduced bugs and conflicts

Balanced progression suitable for long-term servers

Competitive integrity over mod quantity
